headline.title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
headline.summary: A recent analysis reveals that hackers can exploit nine widely-used AI tools to create large-scale botnets, leveraging the limitations of large language models (LLMs) that prevent them from stating "I don't know." This technique, termed "HalluSquatting," highlights vulnerabilities in AI systems that could be manipulated for malicious purposes.

articles.title: AI chip maker SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation, 5 months after last mega round
articles.summary: AI chip manufacturer SambaNova has secured $1 billion in funding, achieving an $11 billion valuation just five months after its previous funding round. This capital raise comes amid speculation that Intel was interested in acquiring the company for approximately $1.6 billion.

articles.title: Agentic AI for IPoDWDM Network Lifecycle Automation: An MCP-Enabled Architecture
articles.summary: The article introduces a distributed, vendor-agnostic multi-MCP architecture designed for the automation and autonomous control of multi-vendor, multi-layer IPoDWDM networks. It highlights the framework's capabilities for end-to-end service lifecycle automation and closed-loop cross-layer control, validated through experiments on an IPoDWDM testbed.

articles.title: Hot French startup ZML releases free product to speed inference across lots of AI chips
articles.summary: French startup ZML has launched ZML/LLMD, a free software product designed to enhance inference speed across multiple AI chips, potentially reducing operational costs for AI applications. The initiative has garnered support from notable figures in the AI community, including Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

articles.title: Driving the Wrong Way: Leveraging Interpretability in End2End Autonomous Driving Models
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to enhance interpretability in end-to-end autonomous driving models by integrating unsupervised dictionary learning as a post hoc module. This method aims to break down driving behavior into semantically meaningful concepts, allowing for better understanding and analysis of the model's decision-making processes.

articles.title: Catalyst Papers in Artificial Intelligence Research: A Landscape on ICLR from 2017 to 2025
articles.summary: The article examines key methodological contributions to AI research, particularly in natural language processing, from 2017 to 2025, highlighting the impact of innovations like word2vec and the Transformer. It also discusses the transparency of ICLR's review process through OpenReview, raising questions about the effectiveness of public reviewer scores in predicting influential papers.

articles.title: A Guiding Framework for K-12 Teachers in Creating AI-powered Learning Technologies through Vibe Coding
articles.summary: The article introduces GAIDE, a guiding framework designed to assist K-12 teachers in creating AI-powered learning technologies through "vibe coding," which enables non-programmers to generate code from natural language prompts. The framework aims to enhance technology integration in education while promoting AI literacy among educators.

articles.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
articles.summary: The article introduces MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model designed to enhance robotic manipulation by integrating 4D geometric priors into the learning process. This approach addresses the limitations of current video-action co-training methods that focus primarily on visual appearance, thereby improving the model's ability to capture the dynamics of temporally evolving geometry for more precise action execution.

articles.title: KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report
articles.summary: KAT-Coder-V2.5 is a coding-focused agentic model designed to operate autonomously within real, executable repositories, moving beyond traditional single-turn code generation. The model's performance is limited by the availability of reproducible environments and verifiable rewards, which the authors aim to improve through an end-to-end agentic post-training framework.

articles.title: Rendering-Aware Bayesian 3D Gaussian Splatting with Native Uncertainty and Adaptive Complexity Control
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach to 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) that incorporates Bayesian principles to provide native uncertainty and adaptive complexity control, addressing limitations in standard training methods. This new framework enhances real-time novel-view synthesis, particularly in scenarios with sparse views or fixed acquisition budgets, by enabling the model to better identify weakly supported geometry and select informative views.

articles.title: Hierarchical Classification via Cascading Feature Elimination: Application to Human Phenotype Ontology-Aligned Facial Phenotyping (FaceMesh2HPO)
articles.summary: The FaceMesh2HPO framework enables the classification of facial phenotypic descriptors aligned with the Human Phenotype Ontology to aid clinical diagnosis, utilizing 3D facial meshes generated from 2D images. The system was developed using annotations from 124 clinicians across 10 disorders and employs a hierarchical PointNet-based pipeline for classification and feature elimination.

articles.title: Depression Symptoms and Relational Patterns in 187k ChatGPT Histories
articles.summary: A study analyzing 187,093 ChatGPT conversations from 766 participants with depressive symptoms reveals insights into how individuals utilize large language models as informal support systems. The research highlights the model's role in providing private and responsive interactions, contributing to understanding user behavior and relational patterns in mental health contexts.
